speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to better understand your condition, have you noticed if the rash appears as raised, red bumps or if it is more of a flat, scaly discoloration?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given your work on a rice farm and with livestock, have you noticed if the rash or the numbness worsens after working in the fields or handling animals? Also, have you seen any small, red, moving insects crawling on your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)

The combination of hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling) is highly characteristic of leprosy. Given your history of working on a rice farm, have you noticed any of the skin lesions as being slightly raised or "thickened" rather than just flat?
